_about: Chemical Plant v0.21's keys for exe patch 130 (v021d_render), as v021d-renderer-1.json gives the other five 0.21 maps: srp_renderer_v021d true at the root of its six client projects (0.21d wet surfaces, rain drops, god rays once a frame), srp_grass_v021d in material/g_stage/effect of the one material its vegetation layers' models use (ported/v021d/flora/grass_l04: 0.21d's grass sway), srp_water_v021d in material/forward/effect of its two water materials (0.21d's wave normals). The files the patch draws with: pack v021d-renderer.
